title: Tech Note: Introduction to Using Collections and Entity Selections in List Boxes
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: list box Data Source: Collection or entity selection

historical_commentary.text: Collection- and entity-selection-backed list boxes remain a core, still-current 4D form-building technique; ORDA's Datastore/DataClass/entitySelection object model described here is exactly how ORDA is still structured today, so this note's fundamentals have aged very well.
related_updates: list boxes bound to collections/entity selections are still the recommended modern approach, largely unchanged since v17
ORDA's core object model (ds -> DataClass -> entitySelection -> entity) is unchanged and remains foundational to 4D development
